subject: [PATCH v6 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a test case to the selftests/mm module to cover a shared-source collapse write race in Linux kernel. The test checks that copy-on-write (CoW) isolation survives when a parent writes to a shared range while its child collapses it. The parent unshares one page every 10ms, starting once the child indicates it is about to collapse. This ensures CoW keeps the two apart: the child sees pre-fork content, and the parent only its own writes. The test prepares for changing how collapse handles fork-shared sources.
